title: Put long records into the scroll area
goal: Use overflow-y: auto to accommodate excess content in a fixed-height box.
summary: There are more and more greenhouse inspection records, and the records at the end of the old page overflow the border. The recording area should only scroll when the height is exceeded.
tasks: Preserve the 124px height of .history so that the vertical scrollbar only appears when the content exceeds the box.
Click "Skip to the last item" and observe whether the record at the end can be rolled into the box.

example.note: When the playback queue content exceeds 10rem, the browser provides a vertical scroll bar on demand.

hint: After fixing the height, the excess rows still need to be processed. The default value of overflow-y, visible, will cause content to continue to be drawn outside the box, and auto can provide scrolling on demand.
